title: The Effect of Regulatory Harmonization on Cross-border Labor Migration: Evidence from the Accounting Profession

scopes.description: Complete author-documented workflow, including the supplied Table 3 Stata pipeline and the companion analyses described in the datasheet and online appendix.

requirements.description: Eurostat EU Labour Force Survey December 2012 core data, annual files for the 29 listed European countries and years 2002–2004 and 2008–2010, usable under the supplied do-file’s EU_LFS_yr_<country><year> names. The code expects source columns country, year, isco3d, countryb, national, yearesid, countr1y, sex, age, marstat, hhlink, qhhnum, hatlevel, hatyear, sizefirm, startime, and coeffy.

routes.location: Eurostat confidential LFS access through an eligible research entity; current access not established
routes.description: The author datasheet identifies this vintage and says access for scientific purposes is subject to entity, proposal, and confidentiality approval. No LFS data are in the package, and the author-reported approval expired in 2019. Current access and compatibility of any approved delivery have not been verified.
routes.expected_period: 29 annual country files for 2002–2004 and 2008–2010, December 2012 LFS core

requirements.description: December 2014 EU LFS core input used by appendix IA5 for the extended aggregate mobility analysis; IA5-specific code, country/file selection, and field mapping are not supplied.

routes.location: Eurostat confidential LFS access through an eligible research entity; current access not established
routes.description: The datasheet identifies the December 2014 LFS core and the detailed IA5 section describes an extended analysis through 2013. Current access and the exact approved files/variables needed by the companion analysis are unverified.
routes.expected_period: 2002–2013 for IA5, using December 2014 LFS core per the datasheet and detailed IA5 section; contents heading also states 1998–2013 and requires clarification

requirements.description: For the complete author-documented target, compatible inputs or author-prepared datasets and exact input mappings for the companion analyses (including Section 3.2 and appendix outputs) remain unspecified. The datasheet names historical sources as discovery leads, but supplies no compatible analysis-ready files or companion input specification.

software.name: Stata
software.description: Version 18 is available according to the existing bounded environment probe. Author compatibility and execution were not tested.

software.name: reghdfe
software.description: The supplied do-file invokes reghdfe; the existing environment probe finds version 6.12.3 in the default/shared adopath.

software.name: ftools
software.description: The existing environment probe finds ftools 2.49.1 in the default/shared adopath, the helper package used by reghdfe.

issues.description: The supplied do-file identifies itself as the main Table 3 analysis. The online appendix reports companion outputs including Table IA8 for legal and business control groups, while the supplied final regression blocks set control to sample_pro; the code prepares matched files for multiple controls but does not provide the appendix regression/output workflow. Other companion analyses and their exact input mapping/order are also not supplied. Request the companion programs or author-approved complete procedures and compatible prepared inputs; do not reconstruct them from appendix values.

The IA5 contents heading says 1998–2013, while the datasheet and detailed IA5 section heading specify 2002–2013. The detailed statement supports the 2002–2013 requirement recorded here, but the title discrepancy needs author confirmation because the IA5 program is absent.

evidence.description: Datasheet identifies the December 2012 LFS core for main analyses and December 2014 core for IA5 extended period; it records historical author access.
evidence.quote: For the main analyses, we use the December 2012 version of the LFS core data. For the analyses of the extended period from 2002 to 2013 (see Section IA5 of the Internet Appendix), we use the December 2014 version of the LFS core data.

evidence.description: The supplied Stata entrypoint states it produces the main Table 3 analysis from the December 2012 LFS for 29 countries and the six listed years.
evidence.quote: This do-file shows the code for the main empirical analysis presented in Table 3 of the paper.

evidence.description: Appendix contents enumerate IA1–IA9 and label IA5 as covering 1998–2013.
evidence.quote: Section IA5: Mobility Trends for Extended Period from 1998 to 2013

evidence.description: Datasheet describes eligibility, proposal approval, and confidentiality requirements for Eurostat confidential data.
evidence.quote: access will be granted only to researchers belonging to a recognised research entity

evidence.description: Datasheet quotes Eurostat restrictions against making copies or removing confidential data from the research entity.
evidence.quote: No copy of all or part of the data may be made and none of the data may leave the research entity’s premises.

evidence.description: Datasheet says the authors’ LFS access was available only until December 31, 2019.
evidence.quote: The LFS dataset can be accessed by the authors until December 31, 2019.

evidence.description: Code loops over a fixed 29-country list and six years and reads one annual LFS file for each country-year pair.
evidence.quote: use EU_LFS_yr_`country'`year', clear

evidence.description: Code retains the variables needed for its raw-to-clean preparation from the LFS input.
evidence.quote: keep country year isco3d countryb_* national_* source_eu15 yearesid countr1y_* sex age marstat hhlink qhhnum hatlevel hatyear sizefirm startime coeffy

evidence.description: Code appends each processed country-year file to the generated raw dataset and saves it.
evidence.quote: save BBCL_Data_raw, replace

evidence.description: Code subsequently reads the raw dataset produced during the preparation stage.
evidence.quote: use BBCL_Data_raw, clear

evidence.description: Code creates the cleaned analysis dataset after sample restrictions.
evidence.quote: save BBCL_Data_clean, replace

evidence.description: The analysis stage later reads the cleaned dataset created above.
evidence.quote: use BBCL_Data_clean, clear

evidence.description: Matching loop saves each dynamic double-matched sample intermediate.
evidence.quote: noisily save "doublematchedsample_`control'_`measure'_onlyrecent`onlyrecent'_coeffyweight`coeffyweight'.dta", replace

evidence.description: Later matching loop reads the double-matched samples produced above.
evidence.quote: use "doublematchedsample_`control'_`measure'_onlyrecent`onlyrecent'_coeffyweight`coeffyweight'.dta", clear

evidence.description: The subsequent loop saves each dynamic ready-for-regression sample after aggregation and merging.
evidence.quote: noisily save "readyforregssample_`control'_`measure'_onlyrecent`onlyrecent'_coeffyweight`coeffyweight'.dta", replace

evidence.description: The regression blocks later read the ready-for-regression samples created above.
evidence.quote: use "readyforregssample_`control'_`measure'_onlyrecent`onlyrecent'_coeffyweight`coeffyweight'.dta", clear

evidence.description: Existing bounded environment probe reports Stata 18, reghdfe 6.12.3, and ftools 2.49.1 available; no author code or dataset was run.
Bounded package inventory lists the supplied do-file, datasheet, and online appendix and no LFS or prepared analysis datasets.
Bounded static inventory of all local/global macro declarations and `mob` references in the supplied 534-line Stata file finds six `mob` uses and no `mob` definition; author code was not executed.
Table IA8 reports double-matched results for legal professionals as control group.
evidence.quote: Panel A: Legal pros as control group

evidence.description: Table IA8 reports a second panel for business people as control group.
evidence.quote: Panel B: Biz people as control group

evidence.description: Final explicit regression block in the supplied code sets its control macro to sample_pro before reading its regression data.
evidence.quote: local control sample_pro

evidence.description: The supplied code declares matching loops for multiple control groups and mobility measures.
evidence.quote: local controlgroups sample_law sample_pro sample_biz

evidence.description: IA5 detailed section range agrees with the datasheet rather than the contents heading.
evidence.quote: Section IA5: Mobility Trends for Extended Period from 2002 to 2013

evidence.description: Repeated rename statement expands the unresolved `mob` macro.
evidence.quote: rename meanmobility meanmobility`mob'

evidence.description: Bounded generic Stata language probe using one temporary dummy variable confirms that a same-name rename succeeds as a no-op and preserves the variable; no author code or study data were run. Combined with the source-wide macro inventory showing no local `mob` declaration, the empty expansion leaves the rename as `rename meanmobility meanmobility`, which is benign.

dependency_review.description: Dynamic doublematchedsample files are generated by the supplied matching loop and then read later in the same do-file; they are intermediates, not external inputs.
Dynamic readyforregssample files are saved after aggregation/merge and then read by later regression blocks; they are generated intermediates.
The dynamic EU_LFS_yr_<country><year> annual files are the required December 2012 LFS inputs for the supplied Table 3 code.
BBCL_Data_raw.dta is initialized, appended to with processed LFS files, saved, and then read inside the same do-file.
BBCL_Data_clean.dta is saved after the sample construction stage and then read by the analysis stage; it is generated by the supplied code.

actions.description: Establish a current, permitted Eurostat research-access route for the December 2012 LFS inputs and, for IA5, the December 2014 core data. Keep confidential data within the approved research entity and do not treat the authors’ expired access as transferable.
steps: Confirm that the project and researchers can apply through a recognized research entity under current Eurostat rules.
Request the required vintage and exact country/year files through the approved access process.
Verify the approved data contain the fields expected by the supplied main do-file; obtain the IA5 field/file mapping from its companion procedure.
Keep any authorized confidential data and analysis within the approved research entity and its permitted access environment.
validation: Confirm current approval and permitted access mode before use.
Before execution, verify that all 29 × 6 main-analysis files are available with the required columns and names.
For IA5, confirm the intended 2002–2013 selection and the 1998–2013 contents-heading discrepancy with the author.
After all authorized inputs and code clarifications are available, run the author program in the permitted environment and compare the resulting Table 3 outputs with the paper.

actions.description: Request the missing companion programs or author-approved complete procedures, compatible input files/specifications, and execution ordering for Section 3.2 and the appendix. The named historical raw sources are clarification leads, not independently reconstructed inputs. Specifically confirm the IA5 period and provide the legal/business-control regression workflow behind Table IA8.
steps: Ask the authors or repository curator for the companion entrypoints, exact prepared-data files or field mappings, and required execution order for the documented non-Table 3 analyses.
Confirm whether the IA5 target is 2002–2013 as stated in the detailed section/datasheet or 1998–2013 as stated in the contents heading.
Request the code/procedure and inputs that generate Table IA8’s legal- and business-professional control panels.
validation: Map each supplied companion entrypoint and compatible input to the documented Section 3.2 and IA1–IA9 outputs.
Verify producer-consumer order, input columns and periods from the author materials without reconstructing variables or final tables from appendix values.
Confirm the Table IA8 control-group panels and IA5 time range against the author-provided workflow.

review_notes: Only one executable author entrypoint is packaged; it is the Table 3 Stata do-file. No LFS or prepared analysis data are included in the bounded package inventory.

The do-file creates BBCL_Data_raw and BBCL_Data_clean, as well as dynamic matching intermediates; the frozen checklist entries for those outputs are reviewed as generated dependencies, while EU_LFS files are mandatory inputs.
No analysis-only scope is supported because neither compatible prepared analysis data nor a verified author-prepared-data route is supplied.
The existing environment probe was reused; no author code, data, downloads, or installations were executed.

The source-wide macro inventory finds no local `mob` declaration, but the provided generic Stata semantic probe confirms the empty expansion becomes a successful same-name rename no-op; no unresolved macro issue or source edit is warranted.
